topic: The team that won a World Cup with 11 players nobody had heard of
hook: Nobody knew their names. They won the World Cup anyway.
script: Nobody knew their names. They won the World Cup anyway. Sri Lanka in 1996 were 500 to 1 outsiders. Their openers invented power hitting. Their spinners baffled every team. In the final they chased down Australia's total with ease. A tiny nation. Zero expectations. One World Cup. Follow for cricket upsets nobody saw coming.
